values.reason: one cross-domain method/evidence coordination service; child domains retain ownership
analysis or safety-case evidence must not become authority to accept residual risk
severity/occurrence/detection products are not a universal cross-domain safety threshold
MPL does not substitute for hazard probability, engineering safety or mission readiness
FMEA/FMECA, hazard, HAZOP, FTA/ETA, STPA, cyber, ecology, debris and planetary protection answer different questions
mission intelligence cannot rewrite or veto root stop/containment/replication controls
Neo/Athene/Achilles roles persist across remote/local/no-model modes
assurance+custodial clearance remains upstream of legitimate authority, risk acceptance and execution lease
older composite reports contain mixed assumptions, targets and outdated claim language
avoid serial recovery-carrier churn and verify their interfaces together
all surfaces remain projections/interactions using the same underlying identity/authority state

promotion_rule: These values remain proposed until owner/governance review. Parent carrier hydration and DBR readback are required before canonical promotion.
